reapack.name: reaper_maxpane
reapack.desc: MaxPane: Nested Docker Layouts for REAPER

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
The post-2.4.0 feedback batch (forum posts #84-95): one visible regression fixed, every layout-editing ask from the thread answered, a debug log you can switch on in the public build, a performance pass driven by a code audit, and a reorganised navigation bar, pane menu and Settings dialog.
Fixed: - macOS: JSFX graphics render inside panes again (2.4.0 regression - a graphics-only JSFX came up flat pane-colored); REAPER's own plugin dialogs keep their native background too. - Windows / Linux: capturing a ReaImGui window that is docked in REAPER's docker no longer crashes REAPER - MaxPane refuses that capture with a message; a workspace tab for such a window waits until it floats. Undock the script window once and capture it floating. - Typing into a captured ReaImGui window works again (Enter, letters, Space reach the window; MaxPane bindings still fire with a modifier). - Projects restore their MaxPane layout once at startup, not twice (no more release + re-capture of every window, no spurious script re-launch). - Window sets (screensets) save and restore containers 2-8 - only the first container was ever written into a set, so a floating second container ignored every window set. Re-save your sets once with the containers open. - Windows: a script window in a pane smaller than 200 px no longer covers the whole container at startup (it stays hidden until the pane grows). - Startup workspaces wait long enough for slow script windows (up to ~50 s) and never re-launch a script that is already running; on Windows and Linux ReaImGui windows restore about two seconds sooner.
Changed: - Navigation bar follows the workflow: Home | Load, Save, Drag-to-dock, Edit layout, Quick Switcher | Settings, Support. - Pane menu grouped into four sections (add windows / this pane / layout and workspaces / MaxPane); the five merge entries live in a Merge submenu, per-pane swaps in a Swap with Pane submenu. Tab menu: organising actions first, Release / Close last. - Settings dialog is about 100 px shorter (fits 900 px displays).
Performance: - Smoother splitter drags and window resizes with heavy plugin UIs (no synchronous repaint of every plugin at 20 Hz). - No more repaint storms: children repaint only the area the container touched; nav bar, pane headers and the drag-to-dock preview repaint only when dirty. - Cheaper window searches during workspace restore; retries back off instead of probing every 200 ms for 40 s. - Debug log is buffered, so leaving it on costs nothing noticeable.
Added: - Layout edit mode: a grid button on the navigation bar (also a pane-menu entry and the "MaxPane: Toggle layout edit mode" action) hides every captured window and shows each pane as a card - drag a card onto another pane to swap them, right-click for split / merge / fit, drag splitters as usual. - Merge Left / Right / Up / Down: four pane-menu entries and four bindable actions (largest neighbour wins when several touch). - "MaxPane: Open Settings" action; the whole pane menu is reachable from a collapsed tab bar via a "Pane" submenu. - Write debug log (Settings, off by default): the public build writes maxpane_debug.log to the system temp folder; "Show log file..." opens the folder with the file selected. - Pane background color (Auto / Black / Custom with the native color picker) and a Black pane-border preset.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
The complete post-2.3.0 feedback batch plus an extended live-testing marathon on macOS: seven bugfixes, five features, and a new window-hosting architecture that makes out-of-process plugin UIs (AUv3-class AUs, Rosetta-bridged x86_64 plug-ins) render inside panes on macOS.
Fixed: - Screensets restore MaxPane window sets again after startup (early LOADs are stashed and replayed). - A MaxPane instance closed with the docker's X no longer resurrects on the next project save/load. - Plugin tabs bound to an FX survive the float being closed and reopened by scripts or by hand (passive re-grab, never re-opens a float you closed). - Reloading a project no longer draws duplicate/misplaced panes. - Windows: FX windows no longer flicker during splitter drags. - Capturing one window from a multi-tab docker no longer hides the docker's remaining windows. - Heavy plugin UIs no longer stutter while dragging splitters or resizing the MaxPane window (~20 Hz throttle, exact final layout on release). - macOS: plugin windows keep to their panes (position snaps back, size clamps at the pane edge; a plugin resizing itself smaller letterboxes on the pane background). - macOS: the area around a plugin smaller than its pane is the pane color instead of white. - Switching dark/light mode recolors panes immediately. - Saving a workspace while follow mode is active now keeps the plugins you see (explicit save materializes follow tabs; automatic persistence still skips them).
Added: - Startup workspace (Settings): load a chosen workspace when the project carries no MaxPane state; never dirties the project. - Tie floating MaxPane to REAPER's main window (Settings; Windows + Linux native owner semantics, default off). - Follow FX slot (pane menu): lock a pane to FX slot N of the selected track - the Logic "Multi" link idiom; slot panes show an "FX slot N" badge. - Focus FX when switching tabs (Settings, default off) - MIDI controllers that follow REAPER's focused FX track the pane. - Merge into occupied panes and Swap with Pane; menu targets named after their active tab, disabled entries say why. - Fit Pane to Window (pane menu): snaps splitters to the captured window's natural size. - macOS: out-of-process plugin UIs (e.g. The God Particle AU, Audio Ease Indoor, Altiverb 7 x86_64) render inside panes via automatic window-hosting. - Settings shows only options that work on your platform (no more "(Windows)" suffixes). - Active-tab accent underline and a proper close glyph with hover feedback.
Notes: - Plugin GUI larger than its pane: Windows shows REAPER's native FX scrollbars; macOS has none (REAPER removed them in 2015) - use "Fit Pane to Window". - Plugin tabs restore only in a project containing those tracks/FX (identities are track-bound by design).
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
A full sweep of the open forum reports, every fix verified live on Windows 11, Ubuntu, and macOS (real 3-display hardware). Headliners: the startup lag is gone, floating-window position restore is fixed at the source on Windows, plus four new features.
Fixed: - REAPER startup lag with MaxPane installed (up to minutes on Windows) is gone: startup cleanup work measured 8.2 s -> 1.1 s on the same machine and state, and REAPER stays responsive while it runs. - Windows: a floating MaxPane finally remembers its position - the restore never worked on Windows at all (geometry messages during window creation clobbered the loaded position). Verified on a physical 3-display setup including a monitor at negative coordinates. - Windows: a maximized floating MaxPane restores maximized, and un-maximizing returns the exact previous rectangle. - A deliberately closed second MaxPane instance no longer resurrects on every project load. - Two instances no longer fight over the same captured window (500 ms flicker ping-pong replaced by arbitration). - FX windows restore with far less flicker when a project loads (~600 ms visible float -> under ~200 ms). - "Open MaxPane automatically on startup" now does what it says (was silently ignored unless MaxPane was open at last quit); an early-open instance re-docks itself. - Workspaces recall toolbars even when they are not already open. - Releasing a captured toolbar can no longer fire one of its buttons mid-gesture. - Windows: left-click-dragging a captured ReaImGui window's background no longer slides it out of its pane (move vetoed at the source; Linux keeps the ~0.5 s snap-back). - Script windows that close and reopen their own sub-windows keep their pane (auto-recapture instead of ejecting the tab). - Stale gray strips / flicker in panes whose window is smaller than the pane are painted over. - Tooltips render at the correct size under Windows display scaling (e.g. 125%).
Added: - Capture a whole track FX chain in one click (pane menu -> "Capture track FX chain"). - Follow mode (experimental): pane 1 re-captures the FX chain as you move between tracks; follow tabs are transient, never saved. - Clean mode: hide the tab bars of all occupied panes (Settings) - captured windows get every pixel. - Pane border color: seven presets, applied live from Settings. - Always-on-top is now a bindable action ("MaxPane: Toggle always-on-top (floating mode)"). - Windows: "Hide floating MaxPane from the taskbar" Settings option (also leaves the Alt-Tab list - Windows design).
Known limitations: - Maximize persistence, taskbar-hide, and the ReaImGui drag-veto are Windows-only; the always-on-top toggle is a no-op on Linux; Linux HiDPI tooltip scaling is not implemented yet. - The v2.2.1 limitations still stand: Linux GL ReaImGui capture requires ReaImGui's "Disable hardware acceleration"; macOS ReaImGui scripts that enforce a minimum window size can resize REAPER's main window.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
ReaImGui script windows (TK Patchbay and friends) get a definitive, per-platform resolution, including two crash fixes found on Linux right after v2.2.0 - this is the release v2.2.0 should have been.
Fixed: - Linux: closing a captured script tab could crash REAPER (use-after-free when the script destroys its own window during the close toggle). - Linux: capturing a GL-rendered ReaImGui window (e.g. TK Patchbay) killed REAPER. Capture now works when ReaImGui's "Disable hardware acceleration" preference is enabled (restart the script after changing it); otherwise MaxPane refuses with an explanatory message instead of crashing. - Windows: captured ReaImGui windows rendered but ignored the mouse - now fully interactive (verified live with TK Patchbay). - Windows: closing a captured untitled ReaImGui script could launch the ReaImGui demo. - A script window enforcing its own minimum size no longer overflows its pane: MaxPane learns the minimum at runtime (Windows/Linux), hides the window below it and explains "needs at least WxH px - enlarge this pane to show it." - Captured ImGui windows dragged by their background no longer slide out of their pane. - The floor-hidden pane hint no longer smears during resize or shows the previous tab's stale frame. - "Release Window" works for captured ReaImGui windows on Linux.
Added: - Capture refusals now explain themselves (message with the reason and the fix) instead of silently doing nothing.
Known limitations: - Linux: capturing GL ReaImGui windows requires ReaImGui's "Disable hardware acceleration" (Preferences > Plug-ins > ReaImGui); restart the script after enabling. - macOS: ReaImGui scripts that enforce a fixed minimum window size (e.g. TK Patchbay) can resize and move REAPER's main window when captured into a pane smaller than that minimum (structural in ReaImGui's macOS backend). Workaround: dock such scripts natively, or keep the pane at least as large as the script's minimum. Scripts without size constraints (e.g. ReaMD) are unaffected.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Windows and Linux reach interaction parity - capture-by-click and drag-to-dock work and show live visual feedback on all three platforms, verified in live debug sessions on Windows 11 and Ubuntu VMs. Plus a hardening pass from a full-code audit.
Added: - Live visual feedback for capture and drag on Windows and Linux: a blue frame outlines the window under the cursor when click-capture is armed, and drag-to-dock frames the exact drop zone - including over panes already occupied by a captured window. The drop always lands where the frame shows. - Natural title-bar drags: when the cursor isn't over a pane but the dragged window's body hangs over one, that pane is targeted as "Add as tab" (all platforms). - MIDI toolbars (all 16 + the piano-roll toolbar) are first-class capturable windows with save/restore. - Collapsible navigation bar (chevron folds it to a thin strip). - Single-window panes can auto-hide their tab bar (new Settings checkbox). - Right-click cancels capture mode on all platforms (on Linux there was previously no way to cancel).
Fixed: - Windows: capture-by-click and drag-to-dock work again (dead since the v2.1.0 redesign). - Linux: docked windows capture by click, floating script windows resolve, clicks respect visual stacking, X11 title-bar clicks resolve via a decoration-band fallback. - Main toolbar can no longer be captured; the startup ghost it used to leave self-heals; toolbar action table repaired (Toolbars 9-16 fired wrong actions, 17-32 now supported). - Capturing a MIDI toolbar from a docker no longer freezes clicks. - Capture failures are no longer silent; failed captures leave the window where it was. - Linux: support/update links open in the browser, released windows get their frame back, dark-mode "Auto" follows the GNOME setting, off-screen geometry is clamped back. - Updater no longer can crash at exit; update responses capped at 1 MB.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Quick fix for a v2.1.0 regression.
Fixed: - Docked toolbars no longer disappear when their pane is made small. The v2.1.0 ReaImGui size-guard (which stops large ImGui windows like TK Patchbay from shrinking REAPER's main window) was too broad and also hid captured toolbars. The guard is now scoped to actual ReaImGui / Lua-gfx hosts only; toolbars, FX windows and other native captures are never hidden and can be docked as small as you like.
Verified on macOS (arm64); Windows and Linux binaries built by CI but not yet runtime-tested for this release.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Feature + stability release. New: MaxPane's layout now round-trips through REAPER Window sets (screensets). Plus the full v2.0.6 bugfix cycle and a dark-mode fix.
Platform testing: verified on macOS (arm64). Windows and Linux binaries are built by CI but not yet runtime-tested for this release - please report issues on the forum or GitHub.
Added: - Screenset integration: saving and recalling a REAPER Window set now restores MaxPane's layout and re-captures its windows, instead of leaving them floating until you re-open MaxPane manually.
Fixed: - Dark mode "Auto (follow system)" now follows the macOS system setting (it was stuck on the light palette under REAPER, which forces an Aqua app appearance). - Manager windows (Routing Matrix, Track Manager) are no longer left floating when MaxPane is closed. - Tab bar and pane dividers no longer stay blank after reopening MaxPane until you nudge a splitter. - Tab-bar hover works when a captured FX/plugin tab has keyboard focus. - Captured ReaImGui windows (e.g. ReaMD) no longer shrink REAPER's main window when their pane is made small. - Floating MaxPane position/size/monitor persists across Cmd+Q and close. - Releasing a captured toolbar no longer randomly fires its buttons. - Windows: reduced the 10-15s startup lag. - macOS: ReaImGui / script windows now appear in the "Open windows" capture menu. - Nav bar no longer shows a grey band when MaxPane is narrow.
Changed: - "Release Window" now returns the captured window to REAPER visible (floating) for all window types; "Close Tab" stays the destructive action. - Capture-by-click redesigned: modal-dialog + core-window safety guards, crosshair cursor, hover name + outline preview, Esc to cancel.
Known limitations: - ReaImGui windows with large UIs (e.g. TK Patchbay) can still shrink REAPER's main window if their MaxPane pane is made very small; ReaMD and standard windows are fine. Full per-window fix in v2.2. - A docked MaxPane placed on a second monitor may return to the main monitor after a restart (REAPER manages docked-window position). Use MaxPane's floating mode, which remembers its monitor.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Bugfix release. Captured plugin windows now restore into MaxPane when a saved project is opened (no longer come back floating). In-pane tab/plugin order is preserved across restore. Windows capture-by-click now works for the MIDI editor.
Fixed: - Captured windows restore into MaxPane on project open (no longer float). Opening a saved project whose MaxPane had docked FX could bring them back floating outside MaxPane, with MaxPane closed or showing the launcher. MaxPane now opens and re-docks its captured windows whenever the opened project carries MaxPane state, whether MaxPane was closed or already on the launcher. - In-pane tab order is preserved across save/restore. When a pane held several captured windows or plugins (most visibly FX across multiple tracks), the tabs could come back in a different order after a reload, because windows that must be reopened are re-captured asynchronously and landed in completion order. Restore now re-sorts each asynchronously-filled pane back to its saved order (by stable FX/window identity) before saving; tab colors and the active tab are re-derived from the corrected order. - Windows: capture-by-click now works for the MIDI editor and other REAPER-native dynamic-title windows (previously the click was dropped and you had to use the "Open Windows" submenu).
This release needs user confirmation - if you reported one of these issues, please test and report back on the forum.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Four-feature follow-up to v2.0.3. AU/VST/JSFX plugin windows now save and restore via workspaces. Hotkey binding moved inline (no more hunting through 200k REAPER actions). Update check on REAPER startup is non-blocking. Settings dialog ~26% smaller.
Added: - AU/VST/JSFX plugin window save and restore. Capture a floating plugin UI into a MaxPane pane, save the workspace, restart REAPER — the plugin reattaches to its pane on workspace load. Identity uses the same (track GUID, FX GUID) pair REAPER itself stores in RPP FXID blocks; survives FX slot reorder and plugin rename. Covers master-track FX and take FX too. - In-MaxPane hotkey binding via REAPER's native shortcut dialog. Right-click a workspace card → "Bind hotkey" now opens a keystroke-capture modal scoped to that specific slot, not the full Actions dialog with 200k entries to filter. - Async update check on REAPER startup. Detached worker thread hits the ReaPack manifest off the main thread; modal pops up only if a newer version is found. New "Automatically on REAPER startup" checkbox in Settings → UPDATES (default ON).
Changed: - Settings dialog compact redesign. ~380 → 280 px tall (~26% shorter), tighter section spacing, UPDATES section split from ABOUT.
Known limitations (read the full CHANGELOG section for details): - Plugin restore needs the matching project open (track + FX GUIDs are project-bound, same as REAPER's own RPP format). - Container FX (nested FX, REAPER 7.06+) not supported in v2.0.4 — top-level track FX + recFX only. - FX moved between tracks won't auto-restore (strict track-GUID match; re-capture in the new location). - Old (v2.0.3 and earlier) workspaces with VST/AU tabs need a one-time re-capture; non-FX tabs (Mixer, FX Browser, toolbars, scripts) restore as before. - Plugin window scaling is plugin-side — most VST/AU GUIs render at a fixed size and won't dynamically resize to fit the MaxPane pane. Resize the pane to match, or use the plugin's own zoom control if it exposes one. Same limitation in REAPER's native FX float windows.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Polish hot-fix on top of v2.0.2. Sharpens the nav-bar icons on Windows, surfaces version / license / support info in the Settings dialog, and lets you check for new versions without leaving REAPER.
Added: - About section in the Settings dialog with version number, MIT license, GitHub link, and Ko-fi / Buy Me a Coffee / PayPal support buttons. - "Check for updates" button in the new About section. Hits ReaPack manifest on github.com and shows a modal if a newer version is out; one-click jump to the Releases page. Manual-only in v2.0.3 (synchronous HTTPS GET blocks UI ~1-3s); automatic check-on-startup planned for follow-up.
Fixed (Windows): - Nav-bar icons no longer render pixelated. Win32 GDI's StretchDIBits default mode (COLORONCOLOR) dropped pixels on downscale; now switches to HALFTONE + SetBrushOrgEx before the blit and restores the previous mode after. Bilinear-equivalent smoothing matches macOS Quartz and Linux LICE.
Fixed (macOS): - Nav-bar icons get high-quality interpolation. BlitBGRABitmapMacOS now sets kCGInterpolationHigh before CGContextDrawImage, matching the Win32 HALFTONE smoothing for visual parity across all three platforms.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Adds Linux x86_64 and aarch64 binaries to the public Release. Fixes three Linux-surfaced issues and unifies the nav-bar icon set across all platforms.
Added: - Linux x86_64 and Linux aarch64 binaries in public Release (closes Linux gap left by v2.0.1; FX Browser close crash from #9 no longer reproduces on REAPER 7.69) - Unified Phosphor icon set across macOS / Win / Linux - replaces per-platform Unicode glyphs
Linux (parity sprint): - Nav-bar icons no longer render as tofu boxes - bitmap path via Phosphor Icons (MIT) - Settings / Save Workspace / Quick Switcher dialogs render content (REAPER's bundled SWELL doesn't substitute the 0.0 default the _BEGIN2 macro emits; switched to explicit-scale _BEGIN with a local SWELL_DLG_WS_DEFAULT_SCALING shim)
Cross-platform: - ReaImGui / Lua scripts whose window title differs from "Script: <filename>.lua" now save with the right action and restore from workspace. Toggle pool stays at the >=2-hit threshold; new script-pool track allows 1 hit plus a single-active-script fallback for titles sharing zero tokens with the action name
Windows (Entry 15 follow-up): - FindWindowEnumProc finds Direct2D plugins with empty WindowText (ReaBeat, Reamix). v2.0.1 closed the save side but missed the search side - workspace-load now falls back to TryGetAppNameFromModule when the title is empty
macOS / Windows users upgrading from v2.0.1 will see a one-off nav-bar icon refresh (Phosphor pictograms replace Unicode glyphs). Functionality unchanged.
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Adds Windows x64 to the public Release. Fixes a class of workspace-restore bugs for captured C++ plugins (ReaBeat, Reamix) and ReaImGui Lua scripts on every platform.
Added: - Windows x64 binary in public Release (closes #8 Windows mouse input) - Current workspace name shown in the navigation bar with dirty indicator - Async workspace Save - no more click-frame freeze for workspaces with many captures - Plugin window action discovery - workspace restore now reopens captured C++ plugins and Lua scripts (previously saved with no action info, silently failed to restore)
Windows native (#8 closed): - WM_NCHITTEST now publishes via DWLP_MSGRESULT - mouse buttons reach DlgProc again - DoCapture style transform reordered: strip WS_POPUP before SetParent (eliminates NtUserSetParent freeze on REAPER native capture) - GWL_EXSTYLE strip removes plugin 3D frame inside the pane - Save / Settings / Quick Switcher dialogs use plugin HINSTANCE (previously nullptr resolved to host EXE) - Native Win32 implementations for ApplyFloatingWindowChrome, IsSystemDarkMode (registry), OpenUrlPlatform (ShellExecute), ClampRectToVisibleScreen, etc. - Capture-by-click no longer self-triggers, walks parent chains correctly for docked plugins - Open Windows menu PID filter (no more Firefox / Program Manager) + tightened acceptance criterion - WS_CLIPCHILDREN / WS_CLIPSIBLINGS in DLGTEMPLATE (no GDI smear); SWP_NOCOPYBITS for Direct2D arbitrary captures - AUTOCHECKBOX + ASCII em-dashes in Settings / Quick Switcher .rc - Debug log path uses %TEMP% on Windows
Cross-platform: - ReaImGui crash on workspace switch fixed - scripts now get a close-fire before reparent - Action discovery works on macOS / Windows / Linux via kbd_getTextFromCmd title-token scoring - Stale-list workspace pass + state==-1 WM_CLOSE handler eliminate floating ghosts after restart - Auto-open survives quit (was_visible reads intent flag, not Win32 parent-chain visibility) - Named command underscore round-trip (GetActionCommandString prepends "_", ResolveActionCommand retries) - DoRelease flips WS_CHILD -> WS_POPUP after SetParent(nullptr) per MSDN
Known issues: - Linux build still pending (blocker #9 FX Browser close crash) - workflow artifact only - Workspaces saved before v2.0.1 with arb:0:<name> entries need re-saving to populate the action ID
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
Major release
New features: - Drag-to-dock: grab any REAPER window from outside and drop it on a pane with live preview (split L/R/T/B, tab-bar, body-center, Shift+drop replace) - Multi-instance: up to 8 independent MaxPane containers per session - Floating mode: detach a container into its own OS window with native chrome, multi-monitor aware, optional always-on-top - Quick Switcher: fuzzy-match across open tabs / workspaces / favorites, bind your own hotkey - 32 workspace slots + 32 favorite slots with bindable hotkeys + "Workspace pickup" single-hotkey-for-all-slots action - Persistent navigation toolbar (Home / Drag / Switch / Save / Load / Settings / Support) - Workspace launcher card grid with mini layout previews on empty containers, plus Home overlay (non-destructive picker) - Reopen last closed tab, pinned tabs, Close Others / to Right / All - Settings dialog with auto-open, nav-bar toggle, dark-mode override - Toast bar for non-fatal feedback; custom Save Workspace dialog
Reliability: - Close mechanism reworked: WM_CLOSE primary, action toggle fallback, stale-list safety net at next REAPER startup - B1-B7, B9, B12-B23, B25, B27 fixed - the "windows fall out of MaxPane" class of bugs eliminated - B27 in particular: ReaImGui plugins (ReaBeat, ReaMD, reamix.me) no longer reopen frameless after capture+release+relaunch - Aggressive startup ghost-cleanup polling cuts visible flash from ~250ms to ~30ms on macOS restart
Build + test: - 4-platform CI matrix (macOS arm64, macOS x86_64, Ubuntu, Windows) - Catch2 unit tests for pure-logic translation units (SplitTree, WorkspaceManager serialization) - ARCHITECTURE.md created from scratch for OSS contributor onboarding
macOS only for v2.0.0. Windows + Linux builds will be added after they pass smoke testing on those platforms (issue #8 Windows mouse input, issue #9 Linux FX Browser close are the open blockers).
Full changelog: https://github.com/b451c/MaxPane/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
